text: Onon fewjooɓe, wata on jonnu jawle ɗen on mo waawaa firlitaade fii majje, ɗen jawle, Alla Waɗiranii on ɗe dartorɗe nguurdam e fiyakuuji jeyaaɓe ɓen, ɓee ɗoo non hanndaa e kippugol reena jawle. Ñamminee e majje holtinon ɓe, wowlanon ɓe konngol moƴƴol, fodon ɓe no moƴƴiri wonnde on jonnitayɓe jawle maɓɓe ɗen si ɓe hellifaama.
